title: Qt: Validate uint preferences more
description:
Fix unsigned integer validation in the Preference Dialog
(PreferenceEditorFrame already works.)

Use our green and red validation for unsigned integers. If a
unsigned integer preference is blank, use the preference default
value instead of "whatever the last valid edited input was."
If an unsigned integer preference is invalid, use the current preference
value (i.e., value when opening the Dialog), instead of "whatever
the last valid edited input was."

We probably should still have a way to disable the OK/Apply buttons
when there's an invalid preference.

Part of #15340.
